name: SENS (DPM++ 2M SDE with reversible terms)
plain: DPM++ 2M SDE with up to two extra reversible correction terms built from the previous one and two predictions. With the corrections at zero it is DPM++ 2M SDE.
math:
Symbols: h = ln(σ/σ'); η.
x' = (σ'/σ)·e^(−ηh)·x + (1 − e^(−h−ηh))·D + m·(D − D_prev)/r, plus noise σ'·√(1 − e^(−2ηh)).
Reversible terms subtract scaled differences of D and D_prev (and D_prev2).
